item.title: The Siren Song of ariaNotify()
item.content:encoded: Mat Marquis details the good-and-dangerous of a new method which we can just make a screenreader say something. There’s a brand new ariaNotify() method — defined by the Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.3 Specification — that provides you with a means of programmatically triggering narration in a screen reader.
